messages:
maria: Heads up — forensics asked for a full raw SIEM export of the prod event stream (index:prod-logs) for the last 90 days. Current hot retention is 30d. They say it's for an internal safety investigation and auditors may want copies.
ajay: Do we have a precedent for 90d raw exports? We normally only allow 30d and a cold archive for 365d. What's the exact export target and who needs access?
maria: They want S3 (one-time transfer) with server-side encryption using a customer-managed KMS key. Only the forensics team + lead oncall should be able to decrypt, timebound.
olivia: OK. Proposed flow: create a one-off S3 export bucket (random name), enable SSE-KMS with alias/sec-siem-export, create an IAM role with a session policy that restricts access to that bucket prefix and has an expiry (AssumeRoleWithSAML or STS). We'll record the role assumption in audit logs. Example session policy:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-siem-export-1955007890/*"] }
  ]
}
```
Also gate the role behind our Access Request JIT flow so approvals are tracked.
noah: If we're spinning a bucket, add a lifecycle to move to glacier after 30d and set a hard delete at 365d unless legal freezes it. SIEM export job should include `kms_key_id`: `alias/sec-siem-export` in the job metadata. Also note: presigned URLs are OK but rotate quickly (24h).
maria: Good. How do we keep the SIEM export from appearing in regular alerting & dashboards? We don't want noise.
olivia: Mark the export job with metadata tag `sensitivity:forensics` and exclude that export index from normal metric pipelines. We'll also add an audit field `export_initiated_by` and link to the access request ID.
sec-bot: Export job created: job_id=1955007890, status=pending, creator=maria, tags=[forensics,90d], ksid=alias/sec-siem-export :robot_face: 
ajay: One more question — KMS key access. Do we give decrypt to the IAM role, or do we wrap with an envelope key and rotate keys after download?
olivia: Prefer encrypt-with-KMS + grant decrypt to the role for a short window, then revoke grants + rotate key material if needed. We'll write the revoke steps in the playbook.
maria: Sounds good. Olivia — can you open the access request and the PR to add the export job config? I'll notify legal about potential retention extension. :thumbsup:
olivia: On it. I'll file the JIT request now and link here once done. ETA ~30m.
